acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given an authenticated user, When they choose to save a search or favorite a document, Then the system securely stores and allows retrieval of these preferences.
Given a search input field, When a user starts typing, Then the system returns a list of suggested queries or matching document titles.
Given the search interface, When a user applies date or education level filters, Then the system returns only documents matching those specific criteria.
notes: Verified backend and frontend integrated search enhancements, filters, auto-suggestions, typo correction, saved searches, and favorites using a combination of Spring Boot JUnit tests and Python Playwright E2E verification.
